candidates.description: This vector represents adjectives and suffixes denoting feasibility, availability, or general qualities, predominantly ending in "-ible" or "-able" across English and Romance languages.
This feature vector activates on words ending with suffixes related to French-derived abstract nouns, adjectives, and proper names, such as "-ment", "-able", and "-ousse".
This feature activates on words and stems related to human sexuality, sexual acts, and anatomical terms.
This feature activates on sexually explicit terms and related adult content vocabulary.
This vector represents common French adverbs of time, degree, and logical connection used to modify verbs, adjectives, or clauses.
This vector is related to abstract cognitive states, mental constructs, and subjective viewpoints.
This feature represents digital or printed media content units, such as images, articles, and documents.

This feature activates on morphological variants and sub-word components centered around the Latin root "-gress" and "-press" (meaning to step or to press), frequently appearing in English and multilingual word pieces involving actions, suppression, or progression.
This vector represents the concept of global computer networks and digital connectivity.
This vector represents words and morphemes related to society, social structures, and sociological contexts across multiple languages.
